gap: No result ChatGPT got states that VIOFO's hardwire kits detect voltage with about 0.3 V of tolerance, so the HK4's lowest 11.8 V cutoff can let the car battery fall to about 11.5 V. That is below the 12.0–12.2 V floor Nexar gives for the AGM/EFB batteries in start-stop cars and the lithium 12 V batteries in EVs, so owners of those cars should set the HK4 slide switch to 12.4 V.
standout_why: I compared Dashlore (cited) and Redline Car Garage (rank 1). Technobezz (cited) returned HTTP 403 and I could not read it. Dashlore says the HK4 or HK6 is needed and that a 12 V socket gives no parking coverage. It advises 'a higher cutoff in cold weather or for an older battery' but gives no voltages and says nothing about EVs, hybrids, start-stop or lithium batteries. Redline says the HK4 is not in the A229 Pro box and needs fuse taps that are also not in the box. It says the HK4 has 'four cutoff options' but gives no values, warns that the OBD port shuts off, and states that it does not cover EVs, hybrids, start-stop or lithium. Neither page gives the 0.3 V detection tolerance, the 11.8–12.4 V values, or a cutoff tied to battery type. The fuse-tap trap is partly covered by Redline. The finding is new and useful, but it changes a setting rather than which products go in the cart, so it scores 2, not 3.
kit_items: dash cam: VIOFO A229 Pro 2CH (4K front + 2K rear). It uses a supercapacitor, and VIOFO's page says buffered Auto Event Detection works only 'with the HK4 hardwire kit (sold separately)'

hardwire kit: VIOFO HK4 Type-C. VIOFO lists it for the A229 Pro and says it does not fit Mini-USB models (A119 V3, A129). VIOFO also states 'Fuse Tap is not included', so buy the Amazon bundle that adds an 8-piece fuse-tap set (ATO, Mini, Micro2, Mini Low Profile) to cover whichever fuse type the car uses
memory card: a high-endurance microSD, for example Samsung PRO Endurance 256 GB. VIOFO support lists a card not on its recommended list as one cause of parking mode stopping unexpectedly

findings.label: Cutoff settings and detection tolerance
findings.value: 4 settings, 11.8 / 12.0 / 12.2 / 12.4 V (23.6–24.8 V on 24 V vehicles); about 0.3 V tolerance in voltage detection
findings.source_title: VIOFO Support Center: What protection voltage should I choose?
findings.note: Article modified 2023-05-17. Worst case at the lowest setting is 11.8 − 0.3 = 11.5 V. At 12.4 V it is 12.1 V. VIOFO calls 12.4 V the safest and says to use it with a parking timer of about 2 h if the battery drains.

findings.label: Recommended cutoff by 12 V battery type
findings.value: Flooded lead-acid 11.8 V; AGM 12.0 V; start-stop (EFB/AGM) 12.0–12.2 V; Tesla/EV lithium 12 V auxiliary 12.2 V
findings.source_title: Nexar: How to set up dash cam parking mode
findings.note: Nexar Team, updated 2026-04-02. Nexar: 'AGM batteries don't tolerate deep discharge as well as flooded lead-acid', and lithium auxiliary batteries 'shouldn't be drawn below this level.' Combined with VIOFO's 0.3 V tolerance, only the HK4's 12.4 V setting keeps the worst case (12.1 V) at or above Nexar's floors for these battery types.

findings.label: Parking mode requirement
findings.value: Buffered Auto Event Detection (15 s before impact), Time-Lapse and Low Bit Rate need the HK4, which is sold separately
findings.note: Read with storecheck. viofo.com price $349.99. VIOFO is not an approved program, so the cart goes to Amazon.

findings.label: Hybrid Parking Mode support
findings.value: Hybrid Parking Mode (switches to low-power impact detection at a set voltage) needs the HK6; the HK4 'does not support voltage-based switching'
findings.source_title: VIOFO Type-C HK6 ACC Hardwire Kit (viofo.com)
findings.note: Read from VIOFO's store search feed; the full product page returned HTTP 429. The listing describes the feature for the A329S, A329T and A329WW, but its title also names 'A229'. I could not confirm whether the A229 Pro gets Hybrid Parking with the HK6, so the kit uses the HK4.

findings.label: Hardwired parking runtime on an EV's 12 V accessory battery
findings.value: About 4 h of parking recording on a Tesla Model X with the cutoff at 12.0 V; the Model 3 'will not work with the Power Magic Pro or the splicing method'
findings.source_title: BlackboxMyCar: How do I install my dash cam in my electric/hybrid vehicle
findings.note: BlackboxMyCar says EVs 'have a very small 12V accessory battery' and 'strongly recommend[s]' an external dash cam battery pack (Cellink NEO, BlackVue B-124) for EVs and hybrids. Single installer report, page footer 2026.

findings.label: Wiring and setup faults that stop parking mode
findings.value: ACC (yellow) on a constant feed means the camera never enters parking mode; ACC on the wrong port means it shuts off at engine-off; a card not on VIOFO's list can stop parking recording
findings.source_title: VIOFO Support Center: Why isn't parking mode working?
findings.note: Article dated 2026-05-21. Maker's troubleshooting list, not a count of user reports.
